name: sklearn CPU demo
description: Tiny scikit-learn fit + metrics.json / 小型训练并写出指标
args:
set -euo pipefail; echo '[cilitrain] installing scikit-learn...'; pip install -q scikit-learn==1.6.1; echo '[cilitrain] training...'; python -u - <<'PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
out = Path(os.environ.get('CILITRAIN_OUTPUT', '/output'))
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
print('loading iris...')
X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
print('metrics epoch=0 loss=1.0 acc=0.0')
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=200).fit(Xtr, ytr)
acc = float(clf.score(Xte, yte))
print(f'metrics epoch=1 loss={1-acc:.4f} acc={acc:.4f}')
(out / 'score.txt').write_text(str(acc))
(out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps({'accuracy': acc, 'score': acc, 'model': 'LogisticRegression', 'dataset': 'iris'}, indent=2))
print('score', acc)
PY
echo '[cilitrain] done'

name: Monitor demo
description: Fake epoch metrics for charts / 模拟 epoch 指标便于监控展示
args:
python -u - <<'PY'
import json, math, os, time
from pathlib import Path
out = Path(os.environ.get('CILITRAIN_OUTPUT', '/output'))
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
ds = out / 'dataset.txt'
if ds.exists():
    rows = max(0, len(ds.read_text().splitlines()) - 1)
    print(f'metrics rows={rows} step=train-from-pipeline', flush=True)
    print(f'[cilitrain] loaded shared dataset rows={rows}', flush=True)
else:
    print('[cilitrain] no dataset.txt (standalone run)', flush=True)
history = []
for epoch in range(1, 8):
    loss = max(0.05, 1.2 * math.exp(-0.35 * epoch) + 0.02)
    acc = min(0.99, 1 - loss)
    print(f'metrics epoch={epoch} loss={loss:.4f} acc={acc:.4f}', flush=True)
    history.append({'epoch': epoch, 'loss': loss, 'acc': acc})
    time.sleep(1)
payload = {'accuracy': history[-1]['acc'], 'loss': history[-1]['loss'], 'epochs': len(history), 'history': history}
if ds.exists():
    payload['dataset_rows'] = max(0, len(ds.read_text().splitlines()) - 1)
(out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
(out / 'summary.txt').write_text(f"final acc={payload['accuracy']:.4f}\n")
print('score', payload['accuracy'], flush=True)
print('[cilitrain] done', flush=True)
PY

name: GPU smoke (nvidia-smi)
description: Needs NVIDIA + device plugin; prints nvidia-smi / 需 GPU 集群，打印 nvidia-smi
args: set -euo pipefail; echo '[cilitrain] GPU smoke'; nvidia-smi; mkdir -p "${CILITRAIN_OUTPUT:-/output}"; nvidia-smi > "${CILITRAIN_OUTPUT:-/output}/nvidia-smi.txt"; echo '{"gpu_smoke":true}' > "${CILITRAIN_OUTPUT:-/output}/metrics.json"; echo '[cilitrain] done'
